description: This file contains unit tests for custom option formatters and formatter resolution in an Orleans-based application, using Xunit. It verifies formatter resolution, registration, conditional overriding, redaction, and named formatters, along with various helper classes and test doubles.

classes.name: TestOptionsWithSecrets
classes.description: Options class with sensitive fields marked for redaction, such as Password and connection string.

classes.name: TestOptions
classes.description: Basic options class containing a single integer field for testing.

classes.name: TestOptionsWithListAndDictionary
classes.description: Options class including list and dictionary properties to test complex property formatting.

classes.name: TestOptionsFormatter
classes.description: Custom formatter for TestOptions, implementing IOptionFormatter, capable of creating named instances and resolving formatters.

classes.name: TestOptionsFormatter2
classes.description: Another custom formatter for TestOptions, illustrating different formatting style and resolver capabilities.

classes.name: TestLoggerFactory
classes.description: A simple ILoggerFactory implementation used in tests to capture log output.

classes.name: TestLogger<T>
classes.description: Generic logger wrapper that delegates to an inner ILogger<T> instance in tests.

classes.name: TestOptionsLogger
classes.description: A test-specific subclass of OptionsLogger used to verify logging behavior in tests.

methods.name: BuildOptionsExpectedResult
methods.description: Creates a test logger factory pre-loaded with specific options output for comparison.

methods.name: BuildNamedOptionsExpectedResult
methods.description: Creates a test logger factory with multiple named options formatters, simulating named formatter scenarios.
